head.title: Plans and prices
head.leadBilling: Free covers everything Mewvo does today. Paid plans add room and tools; buy one for your account or as a gift key for someone else. [Have a key?](/me/redeem)
head.lead: Everything Mewvo does now is free. Paid plans start when Mewvo opens to other servers; until then nothing can be bought.
head.leadSupport: Everything Mewvo does now is free. Paid plans start when Mewvo opens to other servers; until then nothing can be bought. [Join the support server]({url}) to hear first.

plans.note: Limits such as tags follow the plan of the server owner. Perks marked (planned) are not built yet and may change before paid plans start.

faq.title: Questions about pricing
faq.buyNowTest: Only as a test. The checkout works end to end (for you or as a gift key), but no payment provider is connected: no card is asked for and nobody is charged. Perks marked planned are not built yet.
